email_subject: Application - SEO Outreach & Brand Marketing Specialist
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the SEO Outreach & Brand Marketing Specialist role. With hands-on experience in SEO, content, and digital marketing, I've built and optimized websites for traditional and AI-powered search, and I'm eager to focus on off-page SEO and brand visibility.

In my freelance and junior roles, I've handled on-page SEO, keyword research, and content promotion, using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Search Console. I've also built WordPress sites and implemented structured data, which gives me a solid technical foundation for link-building and digital PR. I'm fluent in English and comfortable with outreach and relationship-building.

I'm proactive, organized, and enjoy collaborating with teams to drive organic growth. I'd welcome the chance to contribute to your partner company's outreach campaigns and help strengthen their online authority.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the SEO Outreach & Brand Marketing Specialist position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content, I've developed a strong interest in off-page SEO and brand visibility, and I'm keen to bring my skills to a collaborative, international team.

In my current freelance work and as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've managed on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation for client websites, using Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track performance. I've also built and optimized WordPress sites, implementing structured data and technical SEO audits. While my experience in outreach is still growing, I've developed a solid understanding of backlink acquisition, digital PR, and content promotion through my SEO work and certifications. I'm confident in my ability to plan and execute outreach campaigns, build relationships with publishers and influencers, and identify opportunities for link building and brand exposure.

I'm fluent in English and comfortable communicating with website owners, bloggers, and industry partners. I'm also familiar with online community marketing and have used AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to support research and content workflows. I'm organized, proactive, and enjoy managing multiple projects simultaneously.

I'm eager to contribute to your partner company's outreach initiatives, helping to strengthen domain authority and drive organic growth. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
